data.one_liner: Retrieve current Dart and Flutter SDK runtime versions using nullable getters.
data.what_it_does: Parses the Dart SDK version from the platform and resolves the corresponding Flutter version via an internal mapping table. It exposes both versions at runtime using an easy-to-use API.
use_when: You need to detect the running Flutter or Dart SDK version programmatically
You want to execute version-specific conditional logic or feature flags
You need to log or display SDK version details for debugging purposes
avoid_when: You need precision for non-stable release channels like beta, dev, or master
You are targeting Flutter SDK versions older than 3.0.0
strengths: Enables runtime detection of Flutter SDK versions
weaknesses: Does not support Flutter versions below 3.0.0
Mapped versions may have slight delays on new releases or platform variations
